scope: V1.0 tool registration contract only; HTTP/SDK execution not built
notes: ; v1.0.4 structured output.data DTO is a DESIGN contract, not live SDK proof.

tools.name: pmo_project_get
tools.description: 获取授权项目及当前版本；响应包含权限内 Charter 和 Stakeholder 摘要，完整详情以受限资源视图获取

tools.name: pmo_project_create
tools.description: 只创建本人草稿，不直接授予 sponsor/pm；角色任命需单独邀请并接受
tools.scopeRule: delegated_by active org member; allowedActions includes pmo_project_create; allowProjectCreate=true; org derived from token; sponsor/pm remains unset

tools.name: pmo_project_draft_update
tools.description: 本人未送审草稿可编辑

tools.name: pmo_role_assignment_propose
tools.description: 创建角色任命邀请申请；本人必须在 Web 接受

tools.name: pmo_review_prepare
tools.description: 生成关口检查及材料草稿不形成裁决

tools.name: pmo_review_submit
tools.description: 提交评审申请，不得代审批

tools.name: pmo_milestone_draft_update
tools.description: 只修改尚未冻结里程碑

tools.name: pmo_requirement_deliver
tools.description: 仅标记已交付，不得客户验收

tools.name: pmo_cost_posting_propose
tools.description: 仅凭证候选不得计入实际

tools.name: pmo_cost_forecast_save
tools.description: 修改剩余预测并记录原因

tools.name: pmo_preapproval_spending_list
tools.description: Q4 立项前实际发生支出；以授权项目过滤

tools.name: pmo_risk_update
tools.description: 只能变更描述与风险概率；降低 isBlocking/正式关闭或移交需人工审核

tools.name: pmo_task_update
tools.description: 受控更新任务；不得自动绕过关口

tools.name: pmo_report_submit
tools.description: 提交结构化周报；记录受托原作者

tools.name: pmo_fact_propose
tools.description: 仅 Fact 候选；后端定信任等级

tools.name: pmo_lessons_search
tools.description: 历史教训检索，项目权限过滤

tools.name: pmo_stakeholder_create
tools.description: 仅创建联系信息，不绑定认证客户代表
